selection_reason: Retain all four original preselected failures and add a labelled actual air-attack-and-recovery example that still misses the target.

evaluation_footer: PPO iter32固定TRAIN128｜空中22/128、条件恢复14/22、完整0
caveats: Actual native50Hz body poses and exact contact events. No generated or interpolated motion.
Cases19,23,107,0 were fixed before this assessment. TRAIN19 was motivated by a training success; it is not a blind/random selection.
These are fixed-policy evaluation episodes, distinct from the earlier changing-policy TRAIN19_LANE275_EP1 success.
The terminal image uses the last valid50Hz sample, not an invented exact terminal pose.
The original formal A/B acceptance thresholds remain unchanged.
The fifth caseTRAIN8 is explicitly posthoc, chosen from candidates8/42 by target miss distance among actual air-attack-and-recovery episodes; it is not a predeclared or randomly sampled case.
Court-wide cameras keep actual incoming/outgoing balls and first-landing markers visible, including court-end misses. Recorded geometry and dynamics are unchanged.
